evidence: F2: at the 3 sigma bar the tool printed a rounded '3 sigma' beside its '>= 3 with ratio >= 3 is order' note and a 'no order' verdict. On dev-weak-order-b the Nb point at (1/2, 1/2, 0) sits at 2.959 sigma over the 21 zone-boundary points: its row read sigma 3 (one decimal) and the check 'No order that doubles the cell ... (the strongest, Nb at (1/2, 1/2, 0), is 19x the median, 3 sigma after the correction).' (two significant digits). The ratio had the same fault at its bar: dev-thermal-null's Ti at (1/2, 0, 0) is 2.9976x the median and its row read 3. F3: the Sidak family was the elements the call tested, so analyze_modulations({element: 'Nb'}) on dev-weak-order-b corrected over Nb's own 7 points and gave the same point 3.282 sigma, 'ordered', where the call over every element gave 2.959 sigma, 'no order'. Choosing the element to ask about after seeing the data is selective inference: the family must not shrink with the request. Arm A+ calls the engine for every element, so F3 never touched its sigma; the seed rule of the weak-order cases already reads 'every element tested, as A+ and analyze_modulations test it'. Known answers, both engines: a synthetic weak doubling (Nb +-0.03 A along z in alternate c layers over 0.06 A of noise, three elements, the modulations fixture's 'weak doubling at the bar') sits at 2.976 sigma over the 21 points and stays below the bar, 'no order', with Nb named (its own 7 points gave 3.298 sigma); dev-weak-order-b stays at 2.959 sigma, 'no order', with or without Nb named; the Demo's family is the same for a call naming Ta. Arms A and A+ on dev before and after: F2 and F3 move no record (A+ reads the engine's verdicts, never the tool's text, and asks for every element); the two A+ records that move are plan item 4.3's (2026-10-19-mode-polarisation). What the model sees: analyze_modulations' note now says the correction is over every element's points whichever the call names (tool-results/analyze_modulations.json) and a new sample of a call naming one element (analyze_modulations.element.json); the F2 text appears only near a bar, which the Demo has not. Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
proposed_fix: F3 in the engines (modulations.py displacement_modulations and _decide; workers/modulations.js): the family is every element of the configuration with a site that moves, whichever element the call reports; the payload's family names them (family.elements), its sizes are each element's points and compared modes times their number, so a call without an element is unchanged. analyze_modulations' note says 'corrected over all N zone-boundary points of the configuration's M elements, whichever the call names'. F2 in the tool (copilotTools.js shownBelowBar, barCell, ratioCell, sigmaCell, noCellDoubling): a ratio or sigma below its bar (rules.ratio 3, rules.sigma 3) whose usual rounding reads at or above the bar is shown with the fewest significant digits, from 3 up to BAR_DIGITS_MAX = 6, that stay below it (2.96, not 3), and nearer than that as '<3' in a row and '< 3' in a sentence; the no-order sentence adds ': below the 3 sigma bar' (or 'the 3x bar', or both). A value at or above its bar rounds as before. The row ratio's dataShape admits the '<3' string. Commits 70d2829 (engines) and 6da2b15 (tool). Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19.
